subject:
PO vs Card 

procurement & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@finopsco.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO vs Card 

procurement & next steps

Hi Raj 

great to meet earlier. Quick recap + suggested next steps from our call: 

Summary:
- FinOpsCo prefers centralized AP approvals; purchasing threshold is $5k for PO vs credit card for smaller buys.
- Vendor onboarding requires W9 + vendor setup form + vendor contact.
- Procurement timeline is typically 3-6 weeks for new vendors, faster if purchased via a marketplace.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm who owns vendor setup (AP or IT) and the email to send the onboarding packet to?
2) Would you prefer a PO-backed contract or are you able to process via credit card for an initial POC?
3) Are you interested in purchasing via AWS Marketplace (faster procurement, consolidated billing)?

I attached a draft SOW and our vendor setup XLS to speed onboarding - happy to fill any fields you need. If PO is the path, we can provide a formal quote and standard PO instructions for your AP team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0137

Attachments:
- SOW-template.pdf
- vendor-setup-form.xlsx

From: Raj Patel <raj@finopsco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Li <anna.li@finopsco.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO vs Card 


Thanks Marissa - good call. A few answers below and a couple of asks: 

- AP policy: purchases > $5k require a PO and vendor must be onboarded in our vendor portal.
- Vendor onboarding: AP needs W9 + completed vendor-setup-form + primary vendor contact. I attached our vendor contact vCard.
- Marketplace: yes, if you're available on AWS Marketplace it will make procurement materially faster for us.
- Timeline: estimate 4-6 weeks for new vendor setup + legal review; faster if procured via marketplace or via a credit card for a small POC.

Can you send a formal quote (line-item monthly and annual options) and a short note we can forward to AP to justify the vendor? Also include payment instructions for PO (invoice address, PO numbering, remittance).

Raj
Director, Procurement
FinOpsCo
raj@finopsco.com | (617) 555-0182

Attachments:
- vendor-contact.vcf

Subject: Re: PO vs Card - PO quote + marketplace note

Raj - thanks for the details, super helpful. I've attached a formal quote (monthly and annual pricing tiers) and a short AP-friendly procurement note you can forward. Quick highlights: 

- Option A (PO / Invoice): annual commitment, standard Redwood Master Services Agreement, invoiced net 30.
- Option B (Card / Marketplace): pay-as-you-go via AWS Marketplace; faster onboarding and consolidated billing, but limits some contractual customizations.

If you want, we can: 
- Start vendor onboarding now (we can complete the vendor-setup-form fields on our side and send the W9), and
- Simultaneously open a marketplace procurement path if you'd like faster access for the pilot.

Can you confirm the contract owner and budget owner so we can route the quote appropriately? Once I have that I'll send the DocuSign-ready contract and marked-up instructions for AP.

Thanks - looping in Lauren to help with the marketplace checklist and David for any legal/contract questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments:
- RDW-quote-FinOpsCo-20260603.pdf
- AP-procurement-note.txt
